description: Kept the king to Tuesday and the sixteenth, kept the hired men's ten settled, and said the glass had stayed locked.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Stood by the line and did not ask for a second figure.
name: John Heminges

description: Named Thursday's gowns without a sum, and reported the Rose title he had read.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Wrote the share and did not rule a total.
name: William Shakespeare
